subject: URGENT: duplicate charges in production
body:
Alice, Bob,

We're seeing duplicate charges in production. Three customers reported being charged twice for their February subscription. I've confirmed it in the Stripe dashboard — each has two identical charge events within 30 seconds of each other.

This started after yesterday's deploy (commit abc123). I think it's related to the subscription module changes.

I've paused the billing cron job for now. Need someone to look at this ASAP.

- Dave

subject: Re: URGENT: duplicate charges in production
body:
Dave,

Found it. The new subscription handler sends the charge request, but the retry logic I wrote doesn't check for Stripe's idempotency key properly. If the first request times out (which it did — Stripe had a brief latency spike), the retry sends a second charge without the same idempotency key.

Fix is straightforward: generate the idempotency key BEFORE the first attempt and reuse it on retries.

Pushing the fix now. We'll need to issue refunds for the three affected customers.

- Bob

subject: Re: URGENT: duplicate charges in production
body:
Bob — thanks for the fast turnaround.

Action items from this incident:
1. Bob: add idempotency key tests to the subscription module (by Feb 7)
2. Dave: process refunds for the three affected customers today
3. Carol: add idempotency validation to the new webhook handlers too — same class of bug
4. Alice (me): write up an incident report for the team

Lesson learned: any Stripe integration that retries MUST use idempotency keys. Adding this to our code review checklist.

- Alice
